statement: The scope is 20 edited product photographs on a white background, delivered as JPEG files [F1]. The revisions are one round of colour corrections [F2]. Retouching of the products themselves is not included [F3].
notes: The scope is 20 edited product photographs on a white background, delivered as JPEG files (see project-terms.pdf). The revisions are one round of colour corrections (see project-terms.pdf). Retouching of the products themselves is not included (see project-terms.pdf).
